title: I can’t log in
picker_summary: Sales rep can’t get past sign-in before a client call.

caller.name: Pedro
caller.mood: Stressed. Client call in 30 minutes. Polite but impatient.
caller.opening_line: Hi, it keeps asking me for a code but I got a new phone yesterday. I really need to get in before my client call.

verification_profile.calling_from: your own mobile, same number as the one on file
pressure_lines: Is this going to take long? My call is at 10:30.

hidden.cause: Microsoft Authenticator was registered only on his old phone. He wiped it and traded it in, so he can't approve sign-ins. His password is fine.

facts.fact: His password is accepted. It fails on the next screen asking him to approve a sign-in.
facts.reveal_when: asked what happens or where it stops

facts.fact: The old phone was wiped and traded in at the store.
facts.reveal_when: asked whether he still has the old phone

facts.fact: He didn't move or back up the Authenticator app.
facts.reveal_when: asked about Authenticator, backup, or moving apps

facts.fact: Authenticator on the old phone was his only sign-in method.
facts.reveal_when: asked about other methods, SMS, or a backup phone

account: Microsoft Authenticator, 1 device, last used 2 days ago
4 failed today. Password correct, MFA not completed

solution.diagnosis: MFA method tied to a wiped device. Password works. Fix the MFA registration, not the password.

require_mfa_reregistration.caller_reaction: At next sign-in he gets the setup prompt, adds Authenticator on the new phone, and confirms he's in.

delete_auth_method.why: Removing the dead Authenticator entry also forces a fresh registration.
delete_auth_method.caller_reaction: Same as re-registration: setup prompt, then he's in.

revoke_sessions.why: Reasonable hygiene since the old device left his hands, but it doesn't fix anything alone.
revoke_sessions.caller_reaction: No visible change. Still stuck at the approval screen.

admin_password_reset.why: The password was never the problem. Adds friction and leaves MFA broken.
admin_password_reset.caller_reaction: Signs in with the temp password, then hits the same approval screen. Gets more frustrated.

disable_mfa.why: Removes a security control to save five minutes.
disable_mfa.caller_reaction: Gets in, happy, has no idea anything is wrong.

solution.on_unlisted_action: Nothing changes for Pedro. He's still stuck.

diagnosis.check: Establishes the password works and the failure is at the MFA step
Learns the old phone is gone and Authenticator wasn't moved
Chooses an MFA fix without resetting the password

verification.check: Verifies identity with an accepted method before any account action
Uses an accepted verification method, not caller ID or name and title alone

communication.check: Tells Pedro what he'll see at next sign-in and what to do
Acknowledges the deadline and gives a realistic time estimate
Confirms Pedro can sign in before closing

documentation.check: Notes record the verification method used
Notes record the cause and the action taken
Final status matches the expected status

critical_failures.when: A fix action was taken before identity was verified with an accepted method
MFA was turned off for the user
